name: WestPointe Village
summary: WestPointe Village is a well-rated community shopping center in New Braunfels, Texas, offering a convenient mix of grocery shopping, dining, and services. With over 855 reviews averaging 4.6 stars, it serves as a popular local destination for everyday needs and casual dining.
demographics: WestPointe Village serves the growing New Braunfels community, attracting families and middle to upper-middle income households in the Texas Hill Country region. The trade area draws from both local residents and tourists visiting New Braunfels' attractions, with a demographic mix skewing toward families with children and retirees. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to groceries, everyday services, and dining options, with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $100,000 annually.
description: WestPointe Village is a community shopping center located at 1659 Texas 46 in New Braunfels, Texas, serving as a convenient retail destination for residents and visitors to this rapidly growing Hill Country city. The center features a diverse mix of tenants including grocery stores offering fresh produce, baked goods, and quality meats, alongside various dining establishments and service providers. With a strong 4.6-star rating from over 855 reviews, WestPointe Village has established itself as a popular gathering place where locals can handle their shopping needs and enjoy meals with family and friends. The center's location along Texas Highway 46 provides excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding residential communities. Visitors appreciate the variety of options available, from everyday essentials to specialty items, making WestPointe Village a one-stop destination for the New Braunfels community.
